## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A second parallel rendering of the Mārīcī-dhāraṇī material treated above in [KR6j0484](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0484) (T1255a). Both are attributed to **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)); they differ in textual detail (mantra-form, narrative-frame, iconographic detail), and both were retained in the Taishō because the divergences could not be reduced. Date: Amoghavajra's Chángān activity, 746–774.

**Abstract**

Same Mārīcī-dhāraṇī material as T1255a, but in a slightly different recension. Comparison shows mainly orthographic and phonetic variations in the transliterated mantra-syllables, plus minor compression of the framing-narrative. As elsewhere in the Esoteric corpus, parallel recensions of the same Sanskrit *kalpa*-material were retained because the Indian sources themselves diverged.
